collision_check: Names checked against the live OpenKit3D pack-folder list (218 folders), the live OpenKit 2D pack list, and the stems of earlier Open Kit families. No live pack is named for crypt-undercroft, cistern, wall-fountain, burial-urn, ossuary-cist, memorial-slab or sluice-gate. Nearby live packs (well-water, graveyard, bathhouse, stairs-ladder, dungeon-clutter) are different families. No family was swapped.
judgment_calls: Fountain basin is a recess inside the kit wall thickness so height, width and thickness still match the kit wall; collision fills the bowl on purpose.
Raw FBX (Y-up) facing: the fountain basin faces −Z. Facing after engine import is not verified here.
Memorial carving is recessed 2.2 cm below the walk plane so it stays readable from 13 m without breaking the floor-top pivot cap; collision fills the recesses.
Cistern mouth, sluice opening and the gaps between the cist's legs are real collider openings, not one enveloping hull.
Urn and cist are closed vessels with no remains.
Flat slot albedos with light noise; image nodes are not in the FBX materials.

assets.name: wall-dungeon-fountain
assets.pivot: bottom_centre (0,0,0); wall body on the kit centreline
assets.desc: Kit-sized stone wall module with a recessed spout and basin (the bowl is cut into the 0.34 m thickness, not a projecting fountain). Dark water sits in the bowl. The basin is filled by the collider.

assets.name: prop-cistern-stone
assets.desc: Open masonry water tank with a short plinth, two iron bands and a dark water plane 0.30 m below the rim. Not a well: no winch, no raised parapet, no bucket rope. The mouth is a real opening.

assets.name: prop-urn-stone
assets.desc: Closed lidded stone burial urn on a square plinth, with an iron lid band and a small finial. It does not open; no remains are modelled.

assets.name: prop-ossuary-cist
assets.desc: Closed stone ossuary chest on four short feet, with a slightly oversized lid and three iron straps. No bones or opening. The space between the legs is a real gap.

assets.name: tile-dungeon-floor-memorial
assets.pivot: floor_top: walking surface at z=0, tile extends 0.12 m below; carving is recessed
assets.desc: Walkable 1.5 m floor tile. A 2.2 cm recessed field, an incised border and a bronze rosette sit below the walking surface (the rosette top is 8 mm below z = 0) so the carving stays readable from a 13 m camera without breaking the floor-top pivot.

assets.name: prop-sluice-gate
assets.desc: Small timber-framed drainage sluice on a stone sill, with a raised iron plate and a clear opening under it. Not a keep portcullis: no arch, no pointed bars, about 1.1 m tall.
